items.q: How does the free trial work?
items.a: You get 15 full days of the Starter plan with full access. A credit card is required to activate the trial — but nothing is charged now. On day 15, you choose to continue or cancel, no surprise charges.
Yes. FlowOS is a PWA with smart caching. You can log habits, focus sessions, and transactions without internet. Data syncs automatically when the connection returns.
All data is encrypted in transit and at rest via Supabase with Row Level Security. We never sell data to third parties. You can export or delete everything at any time.

items.q: How is the Life Score calculated?
items.a: The Life Score (0-100) is calculated daily: Habits 30% + Tasks & Projects 25% + Streak 20% + Focus Sessions 15% + Financial Health 10%.

items.q: Can I change plans at any time?
items.a: Yes, upgrade or downgrade anytime. Upgrades take effect immediately with proportional credit. No cancellation fees.

items.q: Which AI model does the AI Hub use?
items.a: The Pro plan uses Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite — fast, efficient and very capable for everyday analysis. Flow+ uses Gemini 3.1 Pro — Google's most advanced model, with deep reasoning and long-term strategic analysis.
